verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's compliance resource center explicitly lists BigQuery-covered attestations, including SOC 1/2/3, HIPAA support and ISO certifications, with downloadable reports per certification. This gives security reviewers documented artifacts for the core of the story. missing for 10: PCI DSS not explicitly named (only generic 'sector/regional programs'), no BigQuery-specific depth beyond a single compliance-center summary, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
